text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for allowing me to 
rest the other day.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Aside from school assignments, I was also 
able to study languages, making for a 
truly productive rest day.
choice_data_list:

text_block_list.text:
Yes. I believe I've had plenty of rest, 
both physically and mentally.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, I once again request your 
candid and unreserved guidance.
